audit.adaptation_reason: Corrected the source English conditional, which incorrectly reads as if b is already parallel to a. The depicted rotation and mathematical target are unchanged. The decorative curved rotation arrow is replaced by the explicit clockwise direction in the question; no geometric condition is changed.
source_visual_observations: Horizontal linea, steep falling linec, oblique lineb perpendicularc atA; source angle1=70° at a/c intersection; curved arrow indicates clockwise rotation.
audit.independent_solution: The acute angle between lines a and c is70 degrees. Since b is perpendicular to c, b makes90-70=20 degrees counterclockwise from a. Rotating b clockwise20 degrees makes it parallel to a, choice D.
